user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Clip tract polygons to Centre County extent
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the tract mapping zones to the supplied Centre County subdivision extent.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the tract polygon layer using the supplied county subdivision polygon layer as the clipping extent. Preserve the tract attributes and geometry in the output GeoPackage.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate total hospital beds within each clipped tract zone.
workflow_steps.instructions: Spatially assign the hospital point features to the clipped tract polygons and sum the BEDS field for each polygon. Write the result as a total_beds attribute in a GeoPackage vector layer.

workflow_steps.title: Create total hospital beds choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from the hospital-beds-by-tract GeoPackage layer, visualizing and classifying the total_beds field. Embed the source artifact and CRS verification metadata.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis B
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.

skills.name: Vector Aggregation and Joins
skills.description: Performs polygon dissolves, feature aggregations, spatial joins, attribute table joins, and spatial buffering on GeoPackage layers.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for spatial joins. Requires projected CRS for metric buffer.
other: Accepts GeoPackage (.gpkg) vector format only. Rejects GeoJSON or Shapefiles.
Accepts CSV tables for attribute join operations.
